phrase.zh: 关联远处的信息，再决定看哪里。
phrase.en: Connect distant details to decide where to look.

visual.zh: 画面中分散的节点以不同强弱的线相连，表现“关注关系”的计算概念。线的粗细不是模型真正算出的权重。
visual.en: Scattered nodes connect with lines of varying strength, suggesting computational attention. Their thickness is not a model’s calculated weights.

background.zh: 2017 年提出的 Transformer 架构以注意力机制处理序列，让不同位置的信息相互关联。注意力是模型内部的计算方式，不等于人类有意识地凝视或理解。
background.en: The Transformer architecture proposed in 2017 uses attention mechanisms to connect information across sequence positions. Computational attention is a model operation, not conscious human looking or understanding.

sources.label: Vaswani et al. · Attention Is All You Need
